# Full ceiling setup audit

Patch 26.20, reviewed 2026-10-19: **476 targets across 173 champions**. 162 setups corrected; 314 retained after this review.

This audit checks the complete authored ceiling inventory against the extracted champion, item and rune snapshot. Each record states the native scaling, rune and shard reasoning, preparation assumptions, and remaining client checks. The ledger binds each review to the exact authored entry, selected formula evidence and complete catalog/champion snapshot; edits to those inputs invalidate the review rather than silently retaining a reviewed label.

A retained setup is a source-based candidate, not a claim of mathematical optimality or in-game verification. Separate proc output, real hit ordering, caps, snapshot behavior, target survival and earned preparation remain part of testing. No globally optimal build or win-rate claim follows from passing this audit.

Reproduce with `npm run audit:ceilings`. The ledger is development data and is not loaded by the website or desktop app. Setup corrections and their test instructions are published through the existing champion-specific build files.

### Aatrox — passive-magic-health-strike

Decision: retained.

Scaling: The passive helper scales from 4% to 10% of enemy maximum HP with champion level, with no direct AD or AP coefficient. Penetration and eligible amplification are the experiment; item AP alone does not increase the core percentage. The normal attack delivering the passive and its healing are separate outputs.

Runes: one Deathbringer Stance bonus magic packet: Press the Attack / Triumph / Legend: Haste / Cut Down / Conditioning / Overgrowth. Aatrox — one Deathbringer Stance bonus magic packet: The native packet is based on enemy health and has no direct AD/AP ratio. The health-state finisher can affect eligible physical/magic output; the remaining runes are access, resource or survival rather than fake offensive scaling. Finisher eligibility follows actual health at each eligible non-true packet, not simply the initial displayed percentage.

Shards: one Deathbringer Stance bonus magic packet: 5007/5001/5001. Offense haste is utility for this stat/flat-coefficient objective; it is not extra damage per hit. Flex scaling health adds finite max HP; only a recorded HP coefficient or equipped conversion turns that into native output. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Preparation: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. No free permanent stacks. Record actual AD/AP and resists. Loaded owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Stop observed scoring on death and report raw overkill separately. Passive ready for one champion attack. Riftmaker legally pre-ramped in separate combat; record actual Shojin stacks reached through qualifying abilities, do not assume four from elapsed time. Abyssal victim inside its actual aura range. No allied MR debuffs. PTA has no ready amplification in the one-hit baseline. Compare a separately prepared three-attack proc with an actual remaining combat buff; keep its burst outside the ability-only subtotal. Overgrowth: use exactly 150 observed eligible unit deaths for any credited HP; no unlimited growth.

Changes: Retained after source and setup review.

Client checks: one Deathbringer Stance bonus magic packet: Ability-damage eligibility for passive amplification must be checked in game. No AP ratio, critical multiplier on the magic packet, or attack-plus-heal sum presented as passive damage. The item set intentionally tests eligibility and is not a proven efficient build.

Sources: `Characters/Aatrox/Spells/AatroxPassiveAbility/AatroxPassive`.
